_about: Terrain types (RULES.md §3) and trench maximums (RULES.md §9.5). 'draw' says how the map shows each type, in docs/STYLE.md colours: 'ground' tints the whole territory (opacity 'groundOpacity'; if a box has two, the higher 'priority' wins), 'texture' is a pattern drawn on top in 'color' ('season': 'autumn' = only Sep–Nov), 'plain' means plain paper, 'badge' marks a fortress. Changing 'draw' means re-running tools/build-map.mjs. Column shifts will be read from here by the combat code in Milestone 5. See docs/DATA.md.

types.name: Flooded
types.effect: −2 columns for attacks into this box.

types.name: Ridge / high ground
types.effect: −1 column. The defender sees everything coming.

types.name: Flanders mud
types.effect: −1 column in Sep, Oct and Nov. Trenches can't go deeper than level 2.

types.name: Chalk
types.effect: Deep dugouts: trenches can reach level 3 from June 1915.

trenchMax._about: Each period runs from 'from' (YYYY-MM) until the next one. 'normal' is the limit for most boxes; 'byTerrain' overrides it for boxes with that terrain (if a box had two, the lower limit wins).
